text:
ashley: Heads-up — ap-southeast1 is experiencing a packing stall. New GPU pods land Pending for >2m despite capacity. Not obvious preemptions in logs. Anyone seeing network/e‑gress quotas flapping?
pranav: seeing same. A bunch of tiny inference pods (0.5 GPU) can't binpack because NVLINK topology forces spread, but we have an interconnect quota bump in us-east only.
ashley: exact. Scheduler is scoring nodes low because of nicLabel:high-egress and `gpu-topo=nvlink` anti-affinity. Example from a stuck pod: `kubectl describe pod io-worker-72` shows Events: "0/8 nodes are available: 4 node(s) didn't match node affinity, 4 Insufficient networkResources."
ben-s: can you paste the `kubectl get nodes -o wide` for those racks? I suspect the egress policer hit on the rack switch — we throttled port because of a customer burst earlier.
julia: also worth checking warm-pool size. If we have many tiny pods, warm nodes with fractional allocation would help. Current warmpool size in ap-southeast1 is 2 (we auto-scaled down last night).
ashley: attaching recent scheduler profile snippet: ```json
{"predicate":"NodeAffinity","failCount":124}, {"predicate":"NetworkResources","failCount":98}, {"priorityScore":"EvenSpread","avg":-12.3}``` Not exact json but gist of metrics.
pranav: what if we relax the `networkResources` predicate temporarily and let packing proceed? Risk: some pods rely on egress bandwidth for model downloads.
ben-s: could do a two-step: (1) increase warm-pool to 6 and pre-provision a couple of NVLINK-capable nodes, (2) relax network predicate on low-priority pods via pod-annotation `inference.rw/soft-network:true`. Ops can watch egress.
ashley: cost concern — warm-pool + extra NVLINK nodes adds ~$18k/month if we keep it steady. But current tail latency and pod churn might be worse. Need approval from finance for transient bump?
julia: short-term mitigation: mark small replicas as packable by adding `topologySpreadConstraint` that prefers same-rack and lower nic label requirement. I'll open PR to default that for tiny-inference.
pranav: I'm going to run a small canary: increase warm-pool to 4 now, then to 6 if metrics don't improve in 10m. Can someone run a quick check on switch egress counters? @sre-bot any alerts for ap-southeast1 egress?
sre-bot: Incident check: No active platform alerts for ap-southeast1 egress. Historical spike at 2026-03-21T23:12Z showed 85% port utilization for 3m.
ben-s: thanks. If no alert, might be kube scheduler thresholds too conservative for our heterogeneous gpu shapes. Proposal: add a schedule-plug that treats `non-degraded-egress` as a soft constraint for pods with `inference.rw/packable=true`. Can prototype with a priorityClass/annotation.
ashley: sounds good. For immediate: pranav, bump warmpool to 4; julia, open PR for spread/annotation change; ben, prototype scheduler tweak next week. I'll message finance about short-term cost. Also adding ticket to run a topology-aware packing sim to quantify cost vs latency.
pranav: done — warm-pool -> 4. Re-scheduling started, 5/6 stuck pods moved to Running within 90s. Will monitor.
julia: PR opened: #4289 add `inference.rw/packable` default for micro-workers and soft topology preference.
ashley: great — keep monitoring for 30m then we can revert changes if any regressions. Thanks all :thumbsup:
